description: This PHP class 'CRT' acts as a wrapper for the AWS Common Runtime (CRT) interface, providing singleton-like access to native CRT functionalities such as error handling, logging, credential management, input stream handling, HTTP messaging, signing, and CRC calculations. It manages the extension's lifecycle and exposes static methods for interacting with the underlying native implementation.

classes.name: CRT
classes.description: A singleton-like wrapper class providing static methods to interact with AWS's Common Runtime (CRT) functionalities, managing extension lifecycle, error handling, logging, credential management, input streams, HTTP messages, signing, and CRC calculations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the singleton instance, creating the extension if not already initialized.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Decrements reference count and releases the extension if no longer in use.

methods.name: isLoaded
methods.description: Checks if the CRT extension is currently loaded.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the CRT is available via the extension.

methods.name: last_error
methods.description: Returns the last error code reported within the CRT.

methods.name: error_str
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string describing an error code.

methods.name: error_name
methods.description: Returns the enum name or identifier for an error code.
